name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop Themes
description: Installable desktop appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: six signature themes with curated wallpapers, font presets, one-click downloadable webfonts, lightweight particle/glow effects, glassmorphism, custom color themes, and a draggable animated Moonfox desktop pet.
author: dsh-desktop-themes contributors
note: This file is human-readable plugin metadata. The authoritative plugin manifest consumed by DeepSeek Harness is the `dsh` field in package.json (bundle and client) plus the packaged cordis.patch.yml layer.
